exposure: Initial COVID-19-related lockdown in Switzerland (16 March 2020 to 10 May 2020)
outcome: Apgar score <7 at 5 minutes of age
cohort: The study included 218,273 singleton births recorded in nationwide statistics of outpatient midwifery services in Switzerland between January 2018 and December 2020.
finding: The risk of most birth outcomes remained unchanged during the first COVID-19 lockdown in 2020 in most parts of Switzerland, though the canton of Ticino, along with Geneva and Bern, showed an increased risk of preterm birth and low Apgar score.
mod_finding: The study did not observe any change in the proportion of caesarean sections during the lockdown period.
gest_age: Preterm birth was defined as <37 weeks gestational age.
